scanned.meaning: todayRows entering selector after Formal normalization/universe filtering; not raw exchange listings

with60Days.meaning: rows present in featureRows whose historyDays>=60; denominator is not raw listings and can be affected by prior history-admission/data-quality logic

missingEnrichment.meaning: featureRows with marketCapYi null; this is a data-readiness diagnostic, not poor-stock quality

baseEligible.meaning: scoreCandidate returned basePassed=true, which also includes downstream rejects after the early admission layer

rrEligible.meaning: rrPassed=true; all preceding gates through RR passed, but final signal-grade C can still reject

channelCounts.meaning: scoreCandidate ok=true rows before final 3+3 pool quota; top-level already covers both price pools

exclusions.meaning: one first-failure reason per evaluated row under current fail-fast gate order

conditionDistribution.meaning: A/B check distribution recomputed on all basePassed rows, including rows already first-failed at earlier downstream precision gates

thousandStockPool.meaning: rerun diagnostics on close>=1000 subset; top-level already includes these rows

invariants: Within one evaluated featureRows set: fullyQualified <= rrEligible <= baseEligible <= featureRows.
Top-level counts include GENERAL and THOUSAND; adding thousandStockPool counts double-counts THOUSAND.
DATA_READINESS missingness remains UNKNOWN/data-quality state, never BAD.
Only explicitly nested stage counts may be used for funnel conversion rates.
compatibilityRule: Do not rename Production JSON fields without a separate compatibility review. Research/reporting layers should attach aliases/semanticVersion instead.
